caseName: New York Mercantile Exchange v. Leist
caseNameFull: New York Mercantile Exchange v. Leist Clayton Brokerage Co. of St. Louis, Inc. v. Leist and Heinold Commodities, Inc. v. Leist

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of Board of Trade of the City of Chicago et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 80-757 granted. Motion of Futures Industry Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 80-936 granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 638 F. 2d 283.
